name: OtpVerification
description: Email/phone OTP verification for guest onboarding and registration (plan-65). One row per target contact (email), holding the SHA-256 hash of the last code sent, its expiry, an attempts counter (brute-force guard), and a verified flag. Identity infra — reached only through the platform /api/v2.0/auth/send-otp and /verify-otp endpoints (AuthService, raised-privilege DataStore), never generic CRUD: dataApi is blocked.

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: The target contact the OTP was sent to and is verified against — the record key.

attributes.name: codeHash
attributes.description: SHA-256 hex of the last OTP sent to this email. The plaintext code is never stored.

attributes.name: expiresAt
attributes.description: Epoch millis after which the code is no longer valid.

attributes.name: verified
attributes.description: True once a matching code has been verified for this email.

attributes.name: attempts
attributes.description: Failed verify attempts since the last send. Reset on send; lockout at the platform max to blunt brute force.
